notable_absence.finding: The Prerequisites section ('The Java SDK is tested against LTS versions OpenJDK... The underlying OS normally makes no difference, but library incompatibilities in Alpine Linux makes a workaround necessary') restates facts already captured with fuller evidence in compatibility.json (same batch). Rather than re-derive fresh relations here for the JDK-version and Alpine-workaround facts, this page only adds the seeAlso links back to compatibility.md, since the substantive claims themselves are identical, not new.

cross_product_finding: The Snapshot Version instructions are Maven/Gradle-build-tool-specific (pom.xml repository block, build.gradle mavenContent block) rather than Server- or Capella-specific - this page's only 'compatibility' axis is the JVM build ecosystem, not Couchbase's own product versions, which is why the only version concept minted here (version:sdk-3-12-2) is a bare distribution-channel fact rather than an availableSince/deprecatedIn claim.
